description: This file defines a Selection interface class for accessibility objects, providing methods to manipulate and query selection states of child elements.

classes.name: Selection
classes.description: An interface indicating an object exposes a 'selection' model, allowing selection of children, with methods to clear, select, deselect, and query selection states.

methods.name: clearSelection
methods.description: Attempts to clear all selections of a Selection.

methods.name: deselectChild
methods.description: Removes a child from the selected list based on index.

methods.name: deselectSelectedChild
methods.description: Deselects a specific child from the selected list based on index.

methods.name: isChildSelected
methods.description: Checks if a specific child is currently selected.

methods.name: selectChild
methods.description: Selects a specific child based on index.

methods.name: get_nSelectedChildren
methods.description: Returns the number of selected children.
